feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: ICE activity is surging ahead of midterms. So is voter turnout.
entry.summary: Across the country, there are reports of heightened ICE activity. Advocates worry about how close it is to midterms, but so far voter turnout is surging.

entry.title: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
entry.summary: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.

entry.title: 'La Bola Negra' falls short of its maximalist ambitions
entry.summary: The new Spanish drama seeks to be a queer-cinema monument for the ages, weaving together three stories about gay men living through times of Fascism and freedom.

entry.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
entry.summary: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

entry.title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
entry.summary: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

entry.title: Binance flags 'potential security issue,' says approximately $6.3 billion impacted
entry.summary: It wasn't immediately clear the extent of the damage hackers might have been able to cause, and Binance had not explicitly confirmed that funds had been pilfered. The company said its teams are "working around the clock" to resolve the issue.

entry.title: Trump's VA killed a home loan program. Thousands of veterans are paying the price
entry.summary: An NPR investigation finds that more than 15,000 military veterans were put into much-higher-cost home loans after the Trump administration cut a key program. Many now pay $1,000 more per month.

entry.title: Richard O'Brien's 'The Rocky Horror Show': Tiny Desk Concert
entry.summary: When you welcome The Rocky Horror Show to the Tiny Desk, it's only fitting to fill the audience with Frank-N-Furters, Magentas, Eddies, Riff Raffs, Brads, Janets, and various other creatures of the night.

entry.title: Democrats seek to weaken the Republican lead in state legislatures
entry.summary: Republicans control 10 more state legislatures than Democrats. That's where most laws on taxes, abortion, crime and schools are made.

entry.title: For voters from immigrant families and new citizens, voting is bigger than themselves
entry.summary: While many young voters are focused on the cost of living in the election, for some from immigrant families, the political calculation — and their votes — is often about even more than the economy.
